content:
As of my knowledge cutoff, the **Burj Khalifa** in Dubai, UAE, is the tallest building in the world, standing at **828 meters (2,717 feet)**. It has held this title since its completion in 2010.

However, the **Jeddah Tower** (formerly Kingdom Tower) in Saudi Arabia is under construction and is designed to surpass it at over 1,000 meters, though it has faced delays.
